# Fate UI v0.9.0-beta1

The 0.9.0 line opens with reliability fixes for the GoalMax completion gate, real shell access for sub-agents, and a working live voice transcription stream.

## GoalMax completion gate

- Fixed the completion-candidate recursion: a failed verification no longer spawns nested follow-up criteria with self-referential "Attach current non-verifier evidence to required criterion: ..." titles. The criteria list stays clean and the goal always returns to a recoverable state.
- Added a recovery path when evidence stops counting: a test/build/lint recorded in the completing turn survives the gate, and rejection messages now state exactly what to do (run a successful test or build after the latest edit, then complete in the same turn).
- Stopped the silent demotion of "satisfied" updates: every dropped update returns an explicit per-criterion rejection naming the failing evidence and why (stale / non-zero exit code / verification kind / unknown id). The API never replies "Goal progress recorded." when an update was dropped.
- Exposed the gate inputs in the agent status capsule: per-criterion evidence ids, and per-evidence current, exit code, and linked criteria — so the agent can self-correct instead of guessing.

## Sub-agent shell access

- Explicitly requested child tools are no longer silently stripped. Requesting `bash` below the required permission now fails with an actionable error (it requires `full-access`), and a full-access child reliably receives `bash` when requested.
- A child can only grant tools its caller already holds; an explicit request beyond the caller's capability is rejected with a clear message instead of silently disappearing.

## Live voice transcription

- Fixed "Live transcription could not start: transcribe_stream_begin: invalid argument". The streaming window used a 300 ms chunk that is not a multiple of the model's 80 ms encoder frame and not part of the Parakeet training menu. Streaming now uses the valid (70, 2, 2) window — 160 ms chunk, 160 ms right context, 320 ms lookahead — restoring push-to-talk live transcription.

## UI

- Performance mode renders the workspace header as a plain rectangle with no separator line.

## Compatibility and installers

No migration is needed. Existing projects, Pi sessions, settings, themes, and folder history are unchanged.

GitHub Actions builds and tests this release on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64. The prerelease contains the installers plus SHA256SUMS:

- Windows x64: NSIS .exe
- macOS arm64 and x64: .dmg and .pkg
- Linux x64: .AppImage and .deb

Public beta installers remain unsigned. Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may show an unknown-publisher warning. Verify downloads against SHA256SUMS.
